comment: The aroma and the melt-in-the-mouth tenderness of the chicken was extraordinary! Reminds me of true royal Awadhi banquets. The packaging is pure luxury.
Unbelievable depth of flavor in the Rogan Josh gravy. Paired with piping hot garlic naan, it is sheer perfection. Royal Feast truly lives up to its name!
Smoky char, juicy meat, perfectly spiced marinades. The combo builder is such an intuitive feature, let me customize my entire family dinner effortlessly.
Even the egg specials are elevated to five-star royal luxury! The gravy has authentic roasted spices and rich texture. Speedy delivery too.
